verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ عَلَى «أَيِّلَةِ ٱلصُّبْحِ». مَزْمُورٌ لِدَاوُدَ إِلَهِي، إِلَهِي، لِمَاذَا تَرَكْتَنِي، بَعِيدًا عَنْ خَلَاصِي، عَنْ كَلَامِ زَفِيرِي؟
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Aijeleth Shahar, A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? [why art thou so] far from helping me, [and from] the words of my roaring?
verses.web: For the Chief Musician; set to “The Doe of the Morning.” A Psalm by David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

verses.ar: إِلَهِي، فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ أَدْعُو فَلَا تَسْتَجِيبُ، فِي ٱللَّيْلِ أَدْعُو فَلَا هُدُوَّ لِي.
verses.kjv: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.web: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.

verses.ar: وَأَنْتَ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلْجَالِسُ بَيْنَ تَسْبِيحَاتِ إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: But thou [art] holy, [O thou] that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
verses.web: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

verses.ar: عَلَيْكَ ٱتَّكَلَ آبَاؤُنَا. ٱتَّكَلُوا فَنَجَّيْتَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
verses.web: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.

verses.ar: إِلَيْكَ صَرَخُوا فَنَجَوْا. عَلَيْكَ ٱتَّكَلُوا فَلَمْ يَخْزَوْا.
verses.kjv: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
verses.web: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَدُودَةٌ لَا إِنْسَانٌ. عَارٌ عِنْدَ ٱلْبَشَرِ وَمُحْتَقَرُ ٱلشَّعْبِ.
verses.kjv: But I [am] a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
verses.web: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.

verses.ar: كُلُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَرَوْنَنِي يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ بِي. يَفْغَرُونَ ٱلشِّفَاهَ، وَيُنْغِضُونَ ٱلرَّأْسَ قَائِلِينَ:
verses.kjv: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, [saying],
verses.web: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,

verses.ar: «ٱتَّكَلَ عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ فَلْيُنَجِّهِ، لِيُنْقِذْهُ لِأَنَّهُ سُرَّ بِهِ».
verses.kjv: He trusted on the LORD [that] he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
verses.web: “He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ جَذَبْتَنِي مِنَ ٱلْبَطْنِ. جَعَلْتَنِي مُطْمَئِنًّا عَلَى ثَدْيَيْ أُمِّي.
verses.kjv: But thou [art] he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope [when I was] upon my mother’s breasts.
verses.web: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.

verses.ar: عَلَيْكَ أُلْقِيتُ مِنَ ٱلرَّحِمِ. مِنْ بَطْنِ أُمِّي أَنْتَ إِلَهِي.
verses.kjv: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou [art] my God from my mother’s belly.
verses.web: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.

verses.ar: لَا تَتَبَاعَدْ عَنِّي، لِأَنَّ ٱلضِّيقَ قَرِيبٌ، لِأَنَّهُ لَا مُعِينَ.
verses.kjv: Be not far from me; for trouble [is] near; for [there is] none to help.
verses.web: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.

verses.ar: أَحَاطَتْ بِي ثِيرَانٌ كَثِيرَةٌ. أَقْوِيَاءُ بَاشَانَ ٱكْتَنَفَتْنِي.
verses.kjv: Many bulls have compassed me: strong [bulls] of Bashan have beset me round.
verses.web: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.

verses.ar: فَغَرُوا عَلَيَّ أَفْوَاهَهُمْ كَأَسَدٍ مُفْتَرِسٍ مُزَمْجِرٍ.
verses.kjv: They gaped upon me [with] their mouths, [as] a ravening and a roaring lion.
verses.web: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.

verses.ar: كَٱلْمَاءِ ٱنْسَكَبْتُ. ٱنْفَصَلَتْ كُلُّ عِظَامِي. صَارَ قَلْبِي كَٱلشَّمْعِ. قَدْ ذَابَ فِي وَسَطِ أَمْعَائِي.
verses.kjv: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
verses.web: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.

verses.ar: يَبِسَتْ مِثْلَ شَقْفَةٍ قُوَّتِي، وَلَصِقَ لِسَانِي بِحَنَكِي، وَإِلَى تُرَابِ ٱلْمَوْتِ تَضَعُنِي.
verses.kjv: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
verses.web: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ قَدْ أَحَاطَتْ بِي كِلَابٌ. جَمَاعَةٌ مِنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ ٱكْتَنَفَتْنِي. ثَقَبُوا يَدَيَّ وَرِجْلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
verses.web: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.

verses.ar: أُحْصِي كُلَّ عِظَامِي، وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ وَيَتَفَرَّسُونَ فِيَّ.
verses.kjv: I may tell all my bones: they look [and] stare upon me.
verses.web: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.

verses.ar: يَقْسِمُونَ ثِيَابِي بَيْنَهُمْ، وَعَلَى لِبَاسِي يَقْتَرِعُونَ.
verses.kjv: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
verses.web: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ، فَلَا تَبْعُدْ. يَا قُوَّتِي، أَسْرِعْ إِلَى نُصْرَتِي.
verses.kjv: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.
verses.web: But don’t be far off, Yahweh. You are my help. Hurry to help me!

verses.ar: أَنْقِذْ مِنَ ٱلسَّيْفِ نَفْسِي. مِنْ يَدِ ٱلْكَلْبِ وَحِيدَتِي.
verses.kjv: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
verses.web: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.

verses.ar: خَلِّصْنِي مِنْ فَمِ ٱلْأَسَدِ، وَمِنْ قُرُونِ بَقَرِ ٱلْوَحْشِ ٱسْتَجِبْ لِي.
verses.kjv: Save me from the lion’s mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
verses.web: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.

verses.ar: أُخْبِرْ بِٱسْمِكَ إِخْوَتِي. فِي وَسَطِ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ أُسَبِّحُكَ.
verses.kjv: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
verses.web: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.

verses.ar: يَا خَائِفِي ٱلرَّبِّ سَبِّحُوهُ! مَجِّدُوهُ يَا مَعْشَرَ ذُرِّيَّةِ يَعْقُوبَ، وَٱخْشَوْهُ يَا زَرْعَ إِسْرَائِيلَ جَمِيعًا!
verses.kjv: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.
verses.web: You who fear Yahweh, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَمْ يَحْتَقِرْ وَلَمْ يُرْذِلْ مَسْكَنَةَ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ، وَلَمْ يَحْجُبْ وَجْهَهُ عَنْهُ، بَلْ عِنْدَ صُرَاخِهِ إِلَيْهِ ٱسْتَمَعَ.
verses.kjv: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
verses.web: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

verses.ar: مِنْ قِبَلِكَ تَسْبِيحِي فِي ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ ٱلْعَظِيمَةِ. أُوفِي بِنُذُورِي قُدَّامَ خَائِفِيهِ.
verses.kjv: My praise [shall be] of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
verses.web: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.

verses.ar: يَأْكُلُ ٱلْوُدَعَاءُ وَيَشْبَعُونَ. يُسَبِّحُ ٱلرَّبَّ طَالِبُوهُ. تَحْيَا قُلُوبُكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
verses.web: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.

verses.ar: تَذْكُرُ وَتَرْجِعُ إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ كُلُّ أَقَاصِي ٱلْأَرْضِ. وَتَسْجُدُ قُدَّامَكَ كُلُّ قَبَائِلِ ٱلْأُمَمِ.
verses.kjv: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
verses.web: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ لِلرَّبِّ ٱلْمُلْكَ، وَهُوَ ٱلْمُتَسَلِّطُ عَلَى ٱلْأُمَمِ.
verses.kjv: For the kingdom [is] the LORD’s: and he [is] the governor among the nations.
verses.web: For the kingdom is Yahweh’s. He is the ruler over the nations.

verses.ar: أَكَلَ وَسَجَدَ كُلُّ سَمِينِي ٱلْأَرْضِ. قُدَّامَهُ يَجْثُو كُلُّ مَنْ يَنْحَدِرُ إِلَى ٱلتُّرَابِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يُحْيِ نَفْسَهُ.
verses.kjv: All [they that be] fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
verses.web: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.

verses.ar: ٱلذُّرِّيَّةُ تَتَعَبَّدُ لَهُ. يُخَبَّرُ عَنِ ٱلرَّبِّ ٱلْجِيلُ ٱلْآتِي.
verses.kjv: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
verses.web: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.

verses.ar: يَأْتُونَ وَيُخْبِرُونَ بِبِرهِ شَعْبًا سَيُولَدُ بِأَنَّهُ قَدْ فَعَلَ.
verses.kjv: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done [this].
verses.web: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.
